records.title: West African Folk-Tales
ancientAuthors: W. H. Barker and Cecilia Sinclair (collectors and editors)
records.translator: not applicable; collected, arranged, and retold in English
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: A 1917 collection of Gold Coast stories gathered through teacher trainees in Accra. The introduction discusses Fanti, Ashanti, and Twi-speaking/Akan peoples; individual story provenance varies, and not every tale is identified with a specific community.

records.title: Jamaica Anansi Stories
ancientAuthors: Martha Warren Beckwith and Jamaican storytellers
records.translator: Martha Warren Beckwith; music recorded by Helen H. Roberts
records.rightsStatus: Project Gutenberg public-domain edition; preserve attribution and review UK reuse before redistribution.
records.notes: A 1924 collection based on stories recorded from Jamaican storytellers during field visits in 1919 and 1921. It is a Jamaican diaspora source, not direct evidence for Akan practice.
